Medium Affected: OTHER

SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 48.420000, -101.353611 (Explicit)

Report Description
***WEB REPORT*** DURING THE DAILY INSPECTION IT WAS DISCOVERED THAT HYDRANT PIT #11 CONTAINED A LARGE AMOUNT OF A FUEL/WATER MIXTURE WITH NO APPARENT SIGNS OF A LEAK. THE SYSTEM WAS NOT BEING USED AT THE TIME AND WAS NOT PRESSURIZED. 600 GALLONS OF THE FUEL/WATER MIXTURE WAS REMOVED. AFTER REMOVAL IT WAS ESTIMATED THAT THERE WERE 450 GALLONS OF JP8 IN THE MIXTURE. ONCE THE FUEL/WATER MIXTURE WAS REMOVED IT WAS DETERMINED THAT THE LOW POINT DRAIN VALVE WAS PARTIALLY OPEN AND THE CAP WAS OFF. THE VALVE AND CAP HAVE BEEN SECURED AND COORDINATION HAS BEEN MADE TO PRESSURE TEST THE PIT.

CURRENT ESTIMATES ARE $500,000 OR GREATER IN DAMAGE ACCORDING TO THE PORT CAPTAIN FROM WSF, MEETING THRESHOLD FOR MAJOR MARINE CASUALTY. CASE PENDS.

Report DescriptionCALLER STATES 2 RAILCARS DERAILED IN A RAILYARD AT THE INCIDENT LOCATION. A LOCOMOTIVE WAS ALSO DAMAGED CAUSING 2400 GALLONS OF DIESEL TO RELEASE ONTO THE BALLAST IN THE YARD. THERE WERE 2 DIFFERENT TRAINS INVOLVED IN THIS INCIDENT. ONE OF THE DERAILED CARS RELEASED APPROX. 3 GALLONS OF CORN SYRUP ONTO THE TRACK BALLAST. THE CAUSE OF THE DERAILMENT IS UNDER INVESTIGATION. YARD JOB DE4116 WAS ON A WESTBOUND MOVEMENT AND THEY SHOVED INTO AN EAST BOUND TRAIN 11914 IN THE YARD. Report DescriptionCALLER REPORTING THE DISCHARGE OF DIESEL AT A MARINE FUEL STATION. DURING REFUELING, A TANK BURP CAUSED THE DISCHARGE OF AN ESTIMATED (.5) CUP OF FUEL TO THE VESSEL AND AN ESTIMATED (1) TBSP TO THE TONGAS NARROWS. CALLER NOTED THE VESSEL WAS ATTENDED THROUGHOUT REFUELING PROCESS AND SORBENT PADS WERE AROUND THE FUEL HOLE. THE TANK WAS NOT FULL AS IT TOOK ON AN ADDITIONAL 15 GALLONS AFTER THE BURP. SORBENT PADS WERE DEPLOYED TO THE VESSEL AND WATERWAY. THERE IS CURRENTLY NO VISIBLE SHEEN IN THE WATERWAY. IT WAS ADDITIONALLY NOTED THE REFUELING STATION AND THE VESSEL HAD APPROPRIATE REMEDIATION EQUIPMENT TO HANDLE THE DISCHARGE.
